events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, featuring anthems like "Supersonic" and "Live Forever".

angles.name: Album Impact
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music forever. What's your stand-out track from the album that launched a thousand singalongs?

events.title: Woodstock Festival: 57 years on
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15 to 18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years since half a million people descended on a farm in New York for Woodstock. Which legendary performance from the festival do you wish you'd seen live?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock 'n' Roll
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley. His music continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who died on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur, who left us far too soon. His lyrics and artistry continue to resonate. What's a Tupac song that means something to you?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His guitar work redefined rock music. What's your favourite Jimi Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks... pure genius. What's your go-to song from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday on September 7.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon with a voice that commands attention. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday on September 21.

angles.name: LG's Big Day
angles.copy: Our kid, Liam Gallagher, is 54 today! Always a legend, always got something to say. What's your favourite Liam moment, Oasis or solo?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. The album still resonates with its message of peace and hope. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: The original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we listened to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod is 25 today! It changed everything for portable music. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the very first Bond film, 'Dr. No', which premiered on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 film or iconic Bond moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His songs continue to inspire and resonate across the globe. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday on October 27.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is undeniable. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Diversity
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled the 'White Album' – a sprawling, diverse masterpiece. Which track from this double album stands out for you?
